title: Find Longest Awesome Substring
description: Find the longest substring that is an awesome string (can be rearranged to a palindrome) in a given string of digits.
pseudocode:
1. mask = 0, maxLen = 0, seen = {0: -1}
2. for i, char in enumerate(s):
3.   mask ^= (1 << int(char))
4.   if mask in seen: maxLen = max(maxLen, i - seen[mask])
5.   for j in range(10):
6.     if (mask ^ (1 << j)) in seen: maxLen = max(maxLen, i - seen[mask ^ (1 << j)])
7.   if mask not in seen: seen[mask] = i

steps.note: Initialize mask and hash map with base case
Check if mask 1000 exists in seen (No)
Check odd-length palindrome possibility by flipping bits
